name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 3px solid #005FCC focus ring with no glow for keyboard navigation. This ensures high visibility for focus indicators without distracting users with motion or glow effects, which can be problematic for those with vestibular disorders or reduced motion preferences. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings, but the clarity for keyboard users outweighs this minor visual adjustment.

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid ring still risks crowding small touch targets on mobile—buttons under 48px need at least 2px clearance to avoid accidental taps. A 2px ring with 2px outer spacing meets WCAG 2.2 while preserving clarity. Test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard nav suite and mobile viewport emulation to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2px outer spacing buffer for all interactive elements. This balances visibility for keyboard users with touch safety on mobile—small buttons (under 48px) won’t overlap or crowd taps, meeting WCAG 2.2 touch target spacing. The trade-off is slightly less prominent than a 3px ring, but the spacing prevents accidental activation, which is critical for users with motor impairments. Test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard nav suite and mobile viewport emulation to confirm.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks fading into busy backgrounds for users with low contrast sensitivity—WCAG 2.2 AA requires 4.5:1 for focus indicators, and a thin ring may not meet that. A 3px ring with 1px outer spacing keeps visibility while still leaving 1px clear for touch targets under 48px. Test both in Playwright MCP’s contrast checker and mobile emulation to settle it.
